name: Devouring Plague
summary: Across the sea, Devouring Plague awaits Forsaken priests who travel far from Lordaeron. Miles Welsh in Thunder Bluff sends the adept to Aelthalyste in the Ruins of Lordaeron, where a signature form of Shadow magic awaits.

sections.title: A Summons Home
sections.body: In Thunder Bluff, Miles Welsh judges Forsaken priests who have honed their divine and shadowy disciplines. Posted among the tauren, he recognizes when an acolyte has grown strong enough for higher mysteries. Miles directs them back to the Ruins of Lordaeron rather than attempt to impart those teachings himself in Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Secrets of Aelthalyste
sections.body: Beneath the city ruins, Aelthalyste waits in the Undercity's War Quarter. One of the foremost mentors of the Forsaken priesthood, she watches over acolytes who weave shadow. The Devouring Plague drains its victim and carries a corruptive force. Aelthalyste entrusts it only to those able to wield that force without succumbing to it.

faq.q: Who sends you on this quest?
faq.answer: Miles Welsh sends you from the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff once your abilities have developed enough. He is a Forsaken priest trainer stationed among the tauren.
Aelthalyste is in the Undercity's War Quarter, among the training rings and dark conduits where Forsaken priests gather.

faq.q: Why can't Miles Welsh teach the spell himself?
faq.answer: Every priest learns Devouring Plague from a priest trainer at level twenty. Miles honors the Forsaken priesthood's hierarchy by sending worthy adepts home to the Undercity, where Aelthalyste can test them.

faq.q: What is Devouring Plague from a lore perspective?
faq.answer: Devouring Plague is a devastating curse practiced by Forsaken priests. Its virulent magical affliction consumes a victim's vitality to restore the caster.

faq.q: Is this quest available to other races?
aliases: can trolls do devouring plague quest
faq.answer: No. This summons is for Forsaken priests, though priests of every race learn Devouring Plague from a priest trainer at level twenty.

faq.q: Why is a Forsaken trainer in Thunder Bluff in the first place?
aliases: why are undead in thunder bluff
faq.answer: After the Forsaken joined the Horde, diplomats and mentors were exchanged across its capitals. Miles Welsh represents the Undercity's spiritual traditions and guides Forsaken traveling through Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a Forsaken priest, you pass an important milestone in your education, moving from basic tenets into the dread Shadow traditions unique to the undead.
As a Forsaken, you embrace harsh afflictions and Shadow magic such as Devouring Plague, unlike the Light practiced in life.
As a member of the Horde, you are linked to distant outposts in Mulgore by spiritual and practical bonds that reach back to the Undercity.
